description: This Java source file defines a generic cache implementation called CaffeineCache that utilizes the Caffeine library for caching. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, invalidating, and managing cache entries, with support for asynchronous operations and optional metrics collection.

classes.name: CaffeineCache
classes.description: A generic cache class implementing caching functionalities using the Caffeine library, supporting async and sync operations, cache configuration, and optional metrics.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a CaffeineCache instance with an AsyncCacheLoader.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a CaffeineCache instance with a null cache loader, for manual cache population.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a CaffeineCache with a specified cache name for metrics collection.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a CaffeineCache with a custom AsyncCacheLoader and optional cache name for metrics.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value asynchronously from the cache as an Optional.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value asynchronously, computing and storing it if absent, using a provided mapping function.

methods.name: getIfPresent
methods.description: Retrieves a value without blocking, returning an Optional.

methods.name: getBlocking
methods.description: Retrieves a value synchronously, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates a cache entry and records metrics if applicable.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the cache asynchronously.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Returns a view of the cache as a ConcurrentMap.
